about: Lisa R. Newman brings over three decades of dedicated service to the fields of estate planning and probate, providing her clients with the legal guidance necessary to navigate the complexities of asset management and inheritance. Owner of the Dallas-based law firm, Lisa Newman Law, PLLC, in Texas, she has committed herself to aiding individuals and families as they make significant decisions during some of life's most challenging transitions. Her practice is a testament to her commitment to offering comprehensive support, ensuring that her clients are able to create lasting legacies with a sense of peace and assurance.

Ms. Newman's academic credentials include a Bachelor of Arts degree in political economy from Tulane University, followed by a Juris Doctor from The Pennsylvania State University – Dickinson Law. Further solidifying her proficiency in financial matters, she earned a Master of Laws (LL.M.) in taxation from the Georgetown University Law Center. This robust educational foundation has equipped her with a profound understanding of the legal, financial and emotional aspects of estate planning and probate, allowing her to offer her clients not just legal advice, but a partnership in planning their futures.

Recognized by her peers and the legal community for her professional excellence, Ms. Newman has been peer-review rated AV Preeminent* through Martindale-Hubbell. Her selection as a D Magazine Best Lawyer in the tax, trust and estate category for the years 2016, 2019, and 2021 further highlights her standing in the field. Furthermore, she is a recipient of a “Very Good” rating on Avvo.

In the realm of estate administration, Ms. Newman’s methodical and accessible counsel supports families through intricate legal processes, ensuring they understand and feel secure in their choices. An active member of the State Bar of Texas and the Dallas Bar Association (Probate and Trusts & Estates Section), she is deeply involved in her professional community. She also contributes her leadership skills to the Dallas Jewish Community Foundation as its chair, exemplifying her commitment to service both in and out of the courtroom.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
